about: Read by packages/deploy/src/cli.ts for the worst-case cost check, and by settings.sh and bootstrap.sh for the allowed regions and instance types.

sources.servers: Linux on-demand prices per hour, from https://b0.p.awsstatic.com/pricing/2.0/meteredUnitMaps/ec2/USD/current/ec2-ondemand-without-sec-sel/<region name>/Linux/index.json, the data behind https://aws.amazon.com/ec2/pricing/on-demand/
sources.public IPv4 address: $0.005 an hour for an in-use public IPv4 address, from https://aws.amazon.com/vpc/pricing/
sources.8 GB gp3 disk: the region's EBS gp3 price per GB a month, from https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AmazonEC2/current/<region>/index.csv, times 8 GB (ROOT_VOLUME_GB in names.sh), divided by 730 hours, rounded up: Stockholm $0.0836, Frankfurt $0.0952, Ireland $0.088
sources.egressUsdPerGb: data transfer out to the internet, first 10 TB a month, from https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/AWSDataTransfer/current/<region>/index.json. AWS's price is per GB; used as the price per 10^9 bytes, which is the same or more if AWS counts GB as 2^30 bytes. The 100 GB a month that are free aren't subtracted.
